description: Runs cargo check (type check without full build) and returns structured diagnostics. Faster than build for error checking.

allTargets.description: Check all targets (lib, bins, tests, benches, examples) (--all-targets)

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

keepGoing.description: Continue as much as possible after encountering errors (--keep-going). Collects maximum diagnostics in a single run.

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

package.description: Package to check in a workspace

release.description: Check in release mode with optimizations (--release)

workspace.description: Check all packages in the workspace (--workspace)

name: check

suggestion.description: Suggested fix text from compiler/clippy children

timings.description: Structured cargo --timings metadata when timing report generation is enabled

title: Cargo Check
